action_summary: The brief for this wave proposed wiring twenty large unwired modules into the front door, on the claim that 1,746 non-test modules of >=180 lines (876,219 lines) were sitting there solved. Measured: that number is 177 modules and 54,409 lines, and the 43 modules the brief names by file all import cleanly -- 40 of them cannot prove anything, none is broken, none is missing a dependency. So this wave does not wire them. It adjudicates them, and it adopts the executable contract on the two whose headline claims are testable in isolation: runtime/futamura_leapfrog_kernel_v1.py, whose 'anytime-valid' e-process now has to survive a seeded null-breach-rate check against Ville's bound (0.0175 measured at alpha 0.05), a power check that a real signal still commits within 12 observations, and a safety check that a hard contradiction revokes a prior COMMIT; and swe_kernel/egraph_and_deductive_synthesizer_v1.py, whose congruence closure is now pinned end to end with the negative control that a + 1 must stay outside a's e-class. Two defects in the adjudicator itself surfaced while sweeping relative paths and were repaired: a ValueError on unresolved paths, and a fail-closed handler that re-raised the same error and aborted every other verdict. PROVEN moves from 6 to 8 of 2,174 substantial modules; 40 titans remain import-only claims, which is the finding.

No external benchmark ran in this wave and nothing here compares to any published system.

routes_considered.why: Adds the three missing operations by composition, and measures them against a from-scratch fixpoint oracle with a no-edges baseline and two controls.

Unification would be a larger capability, but the measured gap was three specific operations over ground facts; rewriting the store would also discard the cascade and diamond-preservation behaviour that already passes.
A protocol bench without the operations would score zero on its own hardest cases; measurement without acquisition adds no capability.
Retrieval cannot answer cascade or absence at any top-k; the baseline is included to show that, not to be improved.
